document.description: base64url CoopEventCanonicalV1 (CBOR) claims: schema (DispatchCapabilityDocumentV1), schema_version, sub, tenant_id, participant_id, role_assignment_id, role, capabilities, features, status_options, iat, exp.

key_id.description: `k-` and the signing key's first four bytes in hex.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 over the document bytes.

required_secrets.description: Presence only; values are never reported.

installation_id.description: Stable per-installation identifier, chosen by the app.

proof.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature by that key over the CoopEventCanonicalV1 encoding of {schema: "DispatchDeviceRegistrationV1", tenant_id, participant_id, installation_id, public_key (bytes)}, the tenant and participant being the caller's.

expires_at.description: The assignment's end plus its grace period; absent while it has no end.

assignment_id.description: The caller's own planned or active assignment the consent covers.

mode.description: `realtime` while someone entitled to the position is watching it.

upload_interval_ms.description: `0`: upload each sample as soon as it is acquired.

device_signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature by the device's registered key over the CoopEventCanonicalV1 encoding of this object's other fields plus schema: "DispatchLocationSampleV1".

code.description: Why a sample was rejected: REJECTED_CONSENT, CLOCK_SKEW, INVALID_SAMPLE, DEVICE_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED, DEVICE_SIGNATURE_INVALID or DEVICE_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT.

reference.description: Opaque proof locator; encrypted at rest. No URL, upload or download.

recorded_at.description: When the server stored it; distinct from occurred_at for offline events.

source.description: Section 5.2: a status is a declaration, so this is always PARTICIPANT.

device_signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature by the registered device's key over the CoopEventCanonicalV1 encoding of this body's other fields plus "schema": "DispatchStatusEventV1". Required when device_id names the caller's active device; the event is then DEVICE_AUTHENTICATED.

event_id.description: Client-assigned UUIDv7. Becomes the stored event's ID, so an offline client can reconcile by the identifier it recorded before uploading. Omitted, the server assigns one. Already in use: 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT.

note.description: Required and nonblank for DELAYED and BREAKDOWN.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. May not exceed server time by more than five minutes.

supersedes_event_id.description: The event this corrects. History is appended, never rewritten.

location_consent.description: The consent covering this trip now, or null: none, revoked or expired.

info.description:
Machine API for the field application and internal services.

Portal endpoints under `/ui` return HTML or Datastar SSE and are not
described here; Section 24.5 keeps them separate from the `/v1` machine
API on purpose.

Self-service: the proof shows the caller's installation holds the key, and
no one approves it. Registering the same key again returns the device. An
installation registered with another key, or to someone else, is a
conflict; a new installation is how a key changes.

Server-sent events while the caller shares location. Each `location-demand`
event's `data` is the policy to apply until the next one: on opening, and
whenever someone entitled to the caller's position starts or stops watching
it. The stream closes when the consent or the role assignment ends.
